name: ǂKhomani Cultural Landscape
description: In the red dunes of South Africa's far north, where the country meets Botswana and Namibia, this vast Kalahari desert landscape covers the same ground as Kalahari Gemsbok National Park. It holds traces of human life stretching from the Stone Age to today. The formerly nomadic ǂKhomani San people survived here for thousands of years, drawing on deep plant knowledge and a worldview tied to the land's features.
